name: What is a tub-to-shower conversion?
description: A tub-to-shower conversion transforms an existing bathtub area into a dedicated shower space by replacing the tub with a shower base and new wall surrounds.

acceptedAnswer.text: A tub-to-shower conversion transforms an existing bathtub area into a dedicated shower space. This typically involves removing the old tub, installing a new shower pan or base, adding new wall surrounds (like tile or acrylic panels), updating the plumbing fixtures, and often replacing the shower curtain with a glass enclosure or door. It's a popular remodeling choice for homeowners seeking improved accessibility, a more modern bathroom aesthetic, or to free up space in smaller bathrooms. The process can vary in complexity depending on the existing plumbing and the desired finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tub-to-shower conversion transforms an existing bathtub area into a dedicated shower space by replacing the tub with a shower base and new wall surrounds.
